items.title: Make the floor fresh-round count storyFilesHash-authoritative (valid-with-advisory)
items.context: In review-assurance-floor.ts evaluateHostVerdictRounds (+ the fallback/degraded paths), when a host verdict's materialHash != current materialHash but its stored storyFilesHash == currentStoryFilesHash(gitCwd,'HEAD',projectRoot), count it as a VALID local round (not ignored), attach the whole-tree-drift re-attestation advisory, and surface it as valid-with-advisory (mirroring evidence-freshness.ts ~305). Reuse currentStoryFilesHash; do not invent a new hash. A verdict with no storyFilesHash, or whose storyFilesHash differs, stays stale/ignored.

happy.desc: Submit host_verdict at materialHash=X with storyFilesHash=S, then drift materialHash to Y while storyFilesHash stays S => evaluateReviewAssuranceFloor reports ok=true, localRounds.validRounds.length >= 1, and advisories[] contains re-attestation advisory string; WHY: covers the core downgrade-accept path that is the entire point of this story

Two host verdicts in different runIds at stale materialHash X, both with storyFilesHash=S matching current => both rounds counted valid (validRounds.length >= 2); WHY: verifies multi-round downgrade-accept not just single-round
Verdict at current materialHash (no drift) with matching storyFilesHash => ok=true, NO advisory emitted; WHY: ensures the downgrade path is not triggered when material is already fresh

edge.desc: Verdict has storyFilesHash=undefined (old pre-storyFilesHash verdict) and materialHash is stale => verdict stays ignored (found 0), no crash; WHY: backward compat with verdicts recorded before storyFilesHash was stored
currentStoryFilesHash returns null (no story files tracked) and materialHash drifted => verdict stays stale (found 0), function does not crash; WHY: guards the null-storyFilesHash-at-floor edge

Degraded single-host fallback record materialHash stale but storyFilesHash matches => fallback.record.valid=true with advisory (not a stale reason); WHY: ensures fallbackRecordFromEvent 4-arg path mirrors escalation

adversarial.desc: Verdict storyFilesHash=sfh-DIFFERENT (different from current sfh-S) and materialHash also stale => verdict stays ignored, floor reports found 0, ok=false; WHY: anti-gaming inverse control -- a real story-file change must not be forgiven by the downgrade

Attacker submits verdict with storyFilesHash matching current but materialDigest also matches current (not stale) => no advisory emitted, round valid normally; WHY: ensures advisory only fires on actual drift, not on fresh-material submissions

verificationEvidence.note: smoke check (a): drift to MATERIAL_Y with storyFilesHash=S unchanged => ok=true, validRounds>=1, re-attestation advisory present
smoke check 'two verdicts in different runIds both stale-material X matching S => validRounds>=2 (both downgraded)'
smoke baseline check: no drift + matching storyFilesHash => ok=true and NO advisory (downgrade fires only on actual drift)
smoke check 'legacy verdict storyFilesHash=undefined + stale material => verdict ignored, found 0, ok=false'
smoke check 'currentStoryFilesHash null (arg omitted) + material drift => effectiveEvents unchanged, verdict stale, found 0, no crash'
smoke check (d): degraded fallback materialHash stale but storyFilesHash matches => record.valid=true with advisory (not a stale reason)
smoke check (c): storyFilesHash differs (S2) + material stale => verdict ignored, validRounds=0, ok=false
smoke baseline: materialDigest equals current (not stale) => no advisory emitted

items.title: Exclude truly-stale verdicts from the per-round duplicate-host-identity check
items.context: So an accumulated prior-submit verdict (stale by both materialHash AND storyFilesHash) cannot create a 'duplicate host/session/key identity' invalid round that forces a brand-new-material re-bind. Only freshness-valid verdicts (current materialHash OR storyFilesHash-matching) participate in a round's identity/validity evaluation; stale ones are filtered out before the duplicate check.

happy.desc: After CHK-001 downgrade: submit two verdicts in same runId -- one fresh (storyFilesHash-matching, materialHash stale, gets downgraded to current) and one truly-stale (both materialHash AND storyFilesHash differ) => the truly-stale verdict is in ignoredVerdicts and the round has exactly 1 passing host (no duplicate-identity error); WHY: the core by-construction claim -- truly-stale verdicts must be filtered before duplicate-identity check

Re-bind scenario: prior round verdicts accumulated at materialHash-OLD + storyFilesHash-OLD (truly stale), new round verdicts at materialHash-X + storyFilesHash-S (downgraded to current) => validRounds contains the new round, old verdicts ignored, no duplicate-identity invalid round created; WHY: real-world re-bind after genuine story change followed by whole-tree drift

edge.desc: Three accumulated verdicts from three different eras: (1) truly-stale (both hashes differ), (2) storyFilesHash-matching (downgraded), (3) current materialHash -- all share same hostId/sessionId/keyId but different runIds => 2 valid rounds from (2)+(3), verdict (1) ignored, no duplicate-identity; WHY: stresses the filter-before-identity-check across three freshness states

adversarial.desc: Two truly-stale verdicts with SAME hostId/sessionId/keyId in SAME runId (both materialHash and storyFilesHash differ) => both ignored, round does NOT appear as invalid with duplicate-identity reason; WHY: ensures that even multiple stale duplicates in same round cannot poison the identity check

verificationEvidence.note: smoke check (b): one downgraded + one truly-stale (both hashes differ) same runId/identity => round valid, no duplicate-identity reason

items.title: Anti-gaming + advisory correctness preserved
items.context: A real story-owned-file change (storyFilesHash differs) MUST still stale the floor rounds (the storyFilesHash downgrade-accept only forgives unrelated whole-tree drift). The re-attestation advisory must be surfaced (not silently swallowed) on a storyFilesHash-accepted floor pass, consistent with B-edf1's escalation-row advisory.

happy.desc: Floor pass via storyFilesHash downgrade => report.advisories is a non-empty array containing the re-attestation advisory string matching pattern /materialDigest drift accepted.*storyFilesHash matches.*re-attestation/; WHY: advisory surfacing is the core requirement -- it must not be swallowed

Degraded fallback record with storyFilesHash match => fallback.record.advisories contains the materialHash-stale-but-storyFilesHash-matches advisory AND fallback.record.reasons does NOT contain materialHash is stale; WHY: the fallback mirror of escalation 4-arg pattern

edge.desc: Multiple verdicts downgraded in same evaluation => advisories array has one advisory per downgraded verdict (not deduplicated); WHY: ensures each downgraded verdict is individually surfaced for audit trail
Fallback record with storyFilesHash mismatch => fallback.record.reasons contains materialHash is stale and fallback.record.valid is false; WHY: inverse control on the fallback path

adversarial.desc: Real story-file change (storyFilesHash differs S->S-prime) with materialHash also drifted => floor reports ok=false, found 0 fresh rounds, reasons include stale material message; WHY: anti-gaming -- a genuine story-owned-file change MUST stale the rounds regardless of how many verdicts exist

Advisory must not appear when storyFilesHash mismatch causes stale (no downgrade triggered) => advisories is empty/absent on a stale-round floor failure; WHY: advisory only fires on accepted-drift, never on rejected-drift; silent swallowing would be caught if advisory appeared where it should not

items.title: Offline smoke/contract test + wire into npm test
items.context: Add a smoke (packages/main, in the existing review-assurance / done-* smoke style) asserting: (a) quorum at material X, then an unrelated whole-tree change (materialHash drifts, storyFilesHash unchanged) => floor still counts the rounds valid with the advisory; (b) a re-bind after such drift does not produce duplicate-identity-invalid rounds; (c) inverse control: a real story-file change (storyFilesHash differs) DOES stale the rounds (found 0). Wire into the root npm test chain.

happy.desc: Run the new smoke script (node packages/main/dist/tasks/review-assurance-floor-storyfileshash-smoke.js) => exits 0, prints PASS or completion message; WHY: proves the smoke itself passes end-to-end from built dist
Run npm test from repo root => exits 0 and output includes the new storyfileshash smoke (grep for the filename or its assertion output); WHY: proves the smoke is wired into the CI test chain

Smoke assertion (a): quorum at material X, unrelated whole-tree drift (materialHash drifts, storyFilesHash unchanged) => floor ok=true with re-attestation advisory present in output; WHY: the primary acceptance scenario

Smoke assertion (b): re-bind after drift with accumulated prior verdicts stale by both hashes alongside fresh storyFilesHash-matching verdicts => no duplicate-identity-invalid round in output; WHY: locks the by-construction claim from CHK-002
Smoke assertion (c): real story-file change (storyFilesHash differs) => found 0 fresh rounds, ok=false in output; WHY: inverse control anti-gaming assertion

Smoke assertion (d): degraded single-host fallback with storyFilesHash match => fallback valid with advisory, and with storyFilesHash mismatch => fallback invalid with materialHash-stale reason; WHY: the fallback path coverage

edge.desc: Existing floor smoke (review-assurance-floor-smoke.js) still passes after changes => exits 0; WHY: regression guard -- the storyFilesHash change must not break the pre-existing floor smoke

Existing escalation smoke (review-escalation-smoke.js) still passes after the one-word export change => exits 0; WHY: regression guard -- adding export to eventsWithStoryFilesHashDowngrade must not alter escalation behavior

adversarial.desc: Build packages/main (npm --prefix packages/main run build) succeeds with zero TypeScript errors before running any smoke => exits 0; WHY: compilation gate -- if the types are wrong (e.g. advisories field not on ReviewAssuranceFloorReport) the build fails before any test

items.title: Register the review-assurance floor as a storyFilesHash-freshness consumer in the process-fact contract
items.context: scope-plan review found that docs/requirements/decisions/story-files-hash-material-drift.md section Process Fact Contract requires the storyFilesHash-freshness semantics to be registered. They already exist as runtime:story_files_hash_freshness_gate (process-fact-levels.ts:308) with the correct semantics, but its gateConsumer enumeration names review runs, verification evidence, and review escalation records, and does NOT yet name the review-assurance floor, which this story makes a new consumer. Update the gateConsumer text in process-fact-levels.ts (and the parallel registry entry text in process-fact-registry.ts if applicable) to include the review assurance floor DONE freshness gate, and confirm node scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs still passes. No new process fact is introduced: the host_verdict and fallback producers (quorum_submit, autopilot_review_submit, review_escalation_fallback_set) already register storyFilesHash and already name the review assurance floor DONE gate as a consumer.
items.userSees: node scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs prints 'Process fact contract verified' (exit 0) and the runtime:story_files_hash_freshness_gate entry gateConsumer names the review assurance floor DONE freshness gate.

happy.desc: After updating the gateConsumer text, node scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs prints Process fact contract verified and exits 0; WHY: the contract verifier is the gate that proves the registration is consistent

edge.desc: The producer entries quorum_submit, autopilot_review_submit, and review_escalation_fallback_set that already name the review assurance floor DONE gate remain consistent with the updated runtime:story_files_hash_freshness_gate consumer text; WHY: avoids contradictory consumer enumerations across producer and runtime entries

adversarial.desc: No new process fact name or category is silently introduced and the registered semantics still require story-owned file changes to invalidate the binding while only forgiving unrelated whole-tree materialHash drift with a re-attestation advisory; WHY: prevents the registration change from weakening the contract or masking a new fact

auditLog.reason: scope-plan reviewer found a spec-required process-fact contract registration gap: the review-assurance floor's new consumption of the storyFilesHash freshness rule must be reflected in the registered gateConsumer enumeration.
